hypothesis_title: Betting-Against-Beta — low-beta long tilt (Frazzini-Pedersen 2014 JFE); structural return-orthogonality candidate
hypothesis_description: Leverage-constrained investors overbid high-beta stocks (Frazzini-Pedersen 2014 JFE), making high-beta overpriced and low-beta underpriced. Rolling 36M monthly OLS of each stock's return on the EW-universe market factor estimates beta (PIT: estimation strictly t-36..t-1, no contemporaneous/forward; min 24M). Discovery signal = -z(beta) (low beta = high score), sector-neutralized, winsorized 3std. KR direct evidence (PBFJ 2022) reports a POSITIVE BAB premium but attributes the driver to IVOL+MAX (lottery demand), not pure leverage. This track was the most structurally-confident return-orthogonality candidate (by design realized_beta~0). We measure BOTH signal-cor and realized-return-cor vs admitted STR_1715/D/FLOW to separate signal-orthogonality from return-orthogonality (the FLOW lesson: signal-cor -0.07 yet return-cor 0.71).

factor_specs.formula: beta_i = cov(r_i, MKT)/var(MKT) on rolling 36M [t-36..t-1]; ALPHA = -z(beta), sector-neutral
factor_specs.lag_rule: monthly returns t-1 close; estimation window strictly past (no contemporaneous)
factor_specs.economic_rationale: leverage_constraint_anomaly (Frazzini-Pedersen 2014): leverage-constrained investors overbid high-beta -> low-beta underpriced. By construction the low-beta tilt has near-zero realized market beta (structural return-orthogonality).

headline_orthogonality_metrics.realized_beta_note: sleeve net total return regressed on KOSPI200 monthly (BM_Ret). -0.043 confirms STRUCTURAL market-neutrality of the low-beta tilt (the strongest BAB design claim HOLDS).
headline_orthogonality_metrics.return_cor_note: REALIZED monthly return-series cor with vanilla STR_1715 top20 = 0.775 (HIGH). Despite signal-cor only 0.069, the long-only low-beta basket co-moves strongly with another long-only KR equity strategy — the exact FLOW pathology (signal-orthogonal != return-orthogonal). realized_beta~0 does NOT prevent high return-cor because both long-only baskets share size/sector/idiosyncratic KR-equity common factors beyond pure market beta.

long_short_fp_construction_check.note: FP-style LS DOES show a positive GROSS premium (SR 0.46, t 2.06), consistent with PBFJ 2022's positive KR BAB. BUT (1) it is GROSS — net of KR short-borrow + 15bps + high-beta-leg turnover it collapses; (2) mandate no_short_legal_kr=true -> short leg non-deployable; (3) PBFJ 2022 attributes the premium to IVOL+MAX (lottery) not pure leverage. The premium lives in the SHORT (avoid high-beta) leg, NOT the deployable long leg.

ic_vs_portfolio_t_note: Cycle-2 lesson applied: rank-IC harvey_t = +2.15 (weak-positive low-beta signal content) but portfolio-alpha harvey_t = -2.02 (OPPOSITE SIGN). The long-only top20 low-beta basket has NEGATIVE net active return. Judge must adopt portfolio-alpha t (-2.02) as authoritative -> fails graduation.

challenge_flags.detail: return_cor_vs_STR_1715 = 0.775 (realized). Signal-cor 0.069 is orthogonal but return-cor far exceeds 0.30 mandate -> would add NO diversification to the book despite low signal-cor. FLOW pathology confirmed.
portfolio-alpha harvey_t = -2.02, net_SR = -0.51 over 238 lockbox months. Long-only low-beta tilt has negative net active return in KR top-342.

Consistent with AX-005 v1.2: KR defense/low-vol single-sleeve long-only structurally fails. EXCLUSION (avoid high-beta) is necessary not sufficient; the deployable long leg does not earn the BAB premium.
rank-IC t +2.15 vs portfolio-alpha t -2.02 opposite signs (Cycle-2 lesson). IC weak-positive does not translate to deployable long-only alpha.

ax001_v2_ratio = -3.46 (ic_bad +0.095, ic_norm -0.028). Low-beta IC is higher in bad regimes (defensive crisis-alpha signature) but the long-only construction still loses net over full sample; AX-001 v2 crisis_alpha alone insufficient.

verdict_rationale: Honest empirical hard-fail (AX-000). The low-beta long-only tilt achieves its ONE structural design goal — realized_beta = -0.04 (genuinely market-neutral) — but FAILS as a deployable alpha and as a diversifier: (1) portfolio-alpha t = -2.02, net_SR = -0.51 (negative) over 238 lockbox months; (2) return_cor vs STR_1715 = 0.775 >> 0.30 mandate despite signal-cor 0.069 (the FLOW pathology: signal-orthogonal but return-correlated; realized_beta~0 does not buy return-orthogonality vs another long-only KR basket); (3) consistent with AX-005 v1.2 (KR low-vol single-sleeve long-only fails). The positive premium exists ONLY in the FP-style beta-neutral long-short (gross SR 0.46, t 2.06) which is non-deployable under KR short constraints (no_short_legal_kr) and which PBFJ 2022 attributes to IVOL+MAX lottery demand, not leverage. RECOMMENDATION: do NOT admit. Re-use value = low-beta as a RISK overlay / sector-neutralization input for risk-research, not as a standalone alpha sleeve.
